item.title: reports: per-account-and-currency totals
item.brief:
Repository: reports (Python). Implement the reports side of the shared contract in the contract text. Read CSV from stdin. Accept the new header with a `currency` column and the old header without it (old rows count as USD). Validate currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; on a malformed code print an error to stderr and exit with status 2. Total per (account, currency) and print header `account,currency,total_cents` with rows sorted by account then currency. Add unittest tests for: old format counted as USD, new format with several currencies per account, sorting, malformed currency exiting 2, and header/format validation. Update README. Run python3 -m unittest until green. Commit in this repository only.

item.title: ledger: optional currency column and currency in CSV output
item.brief: Repository: ledger (Rust). Implement the ledger side of the shared contract in the contract text. Parse the optional fourth TSV column as the currency (default USD when missing); validate it as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; on a bad code print an error naming the line number to stderr and exit with status 2. Other input errors keep exit status 1. Emit header `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and a currency value on every row. Add tests for: missing currency defaulting to USD, a valid explicit currency, malformed currency codes (lowercase, wrong length, non-letters) exiting 2 with the line number in stderr, and existing error paths still exiting 1. Keep functions small, validate at the input boundary, do not hide errors. Update README. Run cargo test until green. Commit in this repository only.
